production_notes: Production icons contain artwork only; spell names and costs are not baked into them.
Painted subjects occupy 90.6% of the canvas on their longest dimension, within the approved 88–92% range.
Battle-rack intent is approximately 60–68 px; every silhouette is also inspected at 40 px.
Water-paid spells use deep blue into cyan and depict visibly wet liquid, never ice or crystal.
Gold is a special payment palette for Aurel-priced spells and is not added to the six element ids.
Aurel-paid spells use abraded brass and amber rather than luminous yellow.
Lighting is consistently motivated from the upper-left.
